subject: Request: Temporary quarterly invoicing + Net-90 bridge for AstraLogic
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@astralogic.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: AstraLogic Procurement <procure@astralogic.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Customer request: Temporary move to quarterly invoicing + Net-90 bridge

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our CFO and procurement team have reviewed the pilot terms and we have a short-term cashflow constraint tied to a delayed series close. To keep momentum on the integration (and the forecasted ARR), Procurement asks whether Redwood can:  

- Move billing cadence to quarterly for two quarters (Q4 + Q1) instead of monthly, and
- Allow Net-90 on invoices issued during those two quarters (Net-90 for Q4 invoice and Q1 invoice), and
- Accept a PO now (attached) and set up an escrow arrangement to secure the first quarter payment once the PO clears.

We appreciate this is outside standard terms. To mitigate risk, we're prepared to:  
- Put 50% of Q1 invoice into a third-party escrow within 10 business days of contract signature, and
- Provide a signed master PO now (attached).

Can you let me know the internal approval path? We need a response this week to align procurement and legal.

Attached: Astra_Procurement_PO.pdf; Q3-payment-plan.xlsx

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Procurement, AstraLogic
samir.gupta@astralogic.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@astralogic.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer request: Temporary move to quarterly invoicing + Net-90 bridge

Team — looping you in. Samir from AstraLogic is asking for a two-quarter experiment: quarterly cadence + Net-90 on those invoices. They attached a PO and a proposed schedule. Key facts:  

- ACV: $420k/year (pilot converts to annual; renewal in 12 months)
- Timing: need approval this week to close procurement window
- Mitigations requested by customer: PO today + escrow deposit to secure payment

My recommendation: Approve conditional temporary terms if Finance/Deal Desk accept the escrow arrangement and Legal signs an amendment. If we approve, we should:  
1) Require 50% of Q1 invoice placed in escrow within 10 business days of counter-signature,
2) Require PO and signed amendment before any billing changes,
3) Set a 180-day review and automatic reversion to monthly billing after Q1 if covenants not met.

Rishi — can you advise on pricing/credit impact (do we need to bake any extra credit or early-pay discount?)
Naomi — can Finance accept this structure if escrow is in place? Are there accounting or revenue recognition concerns?
Marissa — would need your exec sign-off if Finance agrees.

Samir — we’ll try to get a formal answer by EOD Wednesday. Appreciate the PO and the clear plan.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@astralogic.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer request: Temporary move to quarterly invoicing + Net-90 bridge

Avery / team — quick finance read: we can consider a temporary billing cadence shift if the escrow terms are firm and third-party held (not a customer-controlled account). A few clarifying items we need before recommending exec approval:  

1) Escrow provider and mechanics — who will hold funds, timing of release, and triggers (we need a standard escrow agreement or custodian details).
2) PO validation — legal needs to confirm the PO aligns to our T&Cs and that the PO references the signed amendment.
3) Credit exposure — Net-90 increases DSO materially. We need a conservative reserve against the first two invoices; propose a 10% revenue reserve to be assessed at signing.
4) Sales credit / discount — if we provide any concession, do we compensate with a temporary usage discount or reduced onboarding fee? Sales ops to propose options.

I recommend we escalate to Marissa for final exec sign-off once the escrow/custodian is confirmed. If approved, Finance will require an approval memo capturing the escrow provider, reserve amount, and a sunset clause at the 180-day review.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@astralogic.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer request: Temporary move to quarterly invoicing + Net-90 bridge — Exec decision

Team / Samir — after reviewing the ask and Naomi’s finance conditions, I will approve the temporary terms on the following conditions:  

1) Escrow: Third-party escrow with custodian acceptable to Finance; 50% of Q1 invoice delivered to escrow within 10 business days of contract signature. Escrow agreement must be shared with Legal for sign-off.
2) PO & Amendment: Customer PO must be countersigned and we must execute a short amendment stating the temporary billing cadence and Net-90 for the specified invoices.
3) Reserve: Finance to apply a 10% revenue reserve against the two covered invoices until funds are clear in escrow.
4) Sunset & Review: This is a two-quarter pilot with a hard sunset after Q1. We will automatically revert to monthly billing unless both parties agree to extend in writing.
5) No change to SLA or penalty terms; any service credits must be handled per standard contract.

Rishi / Priyom — I'm comfortable authorizing this without a pricing credit if the escrow and reserve are in place. If Sales wants to offer a commercial concession to close, propose it as a one-time onboarding credit (not a recurring discount) and include it in the amendment.

Avery — please confirm you have the escrow provider and updated PO, then loop Legal for the amendment. I’ve attached a short "approval conditions" draft — please finalize and route for signatures.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attached: approval-conditions-draft.docx
